Convertor cli

Introduction

To facilitate cross-platform development of Mini Programs, we provide a converter based on Alipay/Wechat Mini Programs to macle Mini Programs.

Obtained by

Heading for Plugin download page, Download the compiler package Macle_xx.x.x_DevSuite_Converter.zip.

Unzip Macle_xx.x.x_DevSuite_Converter.zip, enter the directory and open package.json in the folder

Usage Mode

Add the converter's command line in the scripts object

Example

{
  "name": "@macle/convertor-embedding",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "description": "Macle convertor embedding",
  "license": "ISC",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "node ../macle-convertor-cli/build/build.js ../macle-convertor-embedding/dist",
    "exchange": "node ./exchange.js",
    "convertor": "macle-convertor-cli -t h5-macle -i ${inputProject} -o ${outputProject}"
  }
}

The meanings of the parameters related to the converter command line are as follows:

Parameter

Name Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
-t String Yes The type of Mini Program that needs to be converted, WeChat is wx-macle, Alipay is ali-macle, H5 is converted to h5-macle
-i String The parent folder of the command line execution location No The converted Mini Program directory
-o String The parent folder of the command line execution location No The converted directory
-e String index.html No Convert H5 to the homepage entrance of the Mini Program (only effective when converting to H5)
-c String npm run build No The command line for H5 project to perform compilation operation (only valid during H5 conversion)
-d String The dist folder at the same level as the command line execution location No The static resource folder generated after the H5 project is compiled (only valid during H5 conversion)

Switch to the converter directory and execute related commands. Taking the above json file as an example, execute npm run convertor
